name: Clovis I
title: King of the Franks (Merovingian)
note: Founded the Frankish kingdom. Converted to Catholic Christianity

name: Childeric III
title: Last Merovingian king
note: Deposed by Pepin III. End of the Merovingians

name: Pepin III
title: King of the Franks (first Carolingian)
note: Deposed Childeric III. Father of Charlemagne

name: Charlemagne
title: King of the Franks, Western Roman emperor

name: Louis I
title: King of the Franks (the Pious)
note: Beginning of the empire's division, leading to the Treaty of Verdun
